1.title: Trump Doled Out $45,000 Cash Gifts to Natalie Harp and Other Aides Last Year
1.summary: The money, listed as “cash gift for the holidays,” was detailed in financial disclosure forms released by the administration.

2.title: Joseph Rice, Lowcountry Lawyer Who Took On Big Tobacco, Dies at 72
2.summary: He challenged tobacco companies as well as the opioid industry, securing multibillion-dollar settlements that also benefited public health.

3.title: New Accuser Sues Foundations With Ties to Cesar Chavez
3.summary: The lawsuit, the first of its kind since revelations against the union leader emerged this year, accuses two foundations of failing to prevent “abusive, rogue and inappropriate” behavior.

4.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
4.summary: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

5.title: Mother demands answers, weeks after black woman found hanging from Mississippi tree
5.summary: Her demands for information about what happened to Tasia Fortune have been echoed by shocked locals.

6.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
6.summary: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.
